name: Amber Resin
description: The product suspended inside a block of amber casting resin still setting, a slow train of trapped bubbles standing around it and the whole block backlit so the resin transmits and glows. A real caster's block on a bench, with pour artefacts — meniscus, sink mark, schlieren — not fossil fantasy.
lighting: Hard backlight through the block, transmitted glow
subject: product
prompt: the subject is the hero of the frame and occupies roughly 50 percent of the frame height, clearly readable but optically altered by the centimetres of resin standing in front of it, suspended deep inside a rectangular block of warm amber casting resin that is still setting, its outline visibly broken, stepped and displaced where the block's front face refracts it, at least two large bubbles sitting in the near resin directly in front of the object and rendered distinctly softer than it, one schlieren swirl passing across it and partly occluding it, so resin unmistakably stands in front of the object and not only behind it, focus falling off within the block so the front-face bubbles sit slightly soft, the object holds the one sharp plane and the rear face with its schlieren goes clearly softer, the block a genuinely poured object with slightly soft top-edge radii, a faint meniscus at its upper surface and one shallow sink mark where the resin has drawn down as it cures, standing on a scarred dark workbench top, a slow train of trapped bubbles standing frozen around the object, a few large ones near the surface and a fine sparse column of pinpricks trailing down, slightly elongated where the pour was thicker, a hard backlight directly behind the block firing through it so the resin transmits as glowing honey with the deepest amber pooling in the thickest section, the object blocking that light and therefore throwing a dark shadow forward through the resin toward camera with one bright caustic thrown beside it onto the bench in front, one small cool top light putting a single clean specular on the block's front face so the surface plane reads, colour running from pale gold at the thin edges through honey to deep burnt orange at the core against a near-black surround, no bright halo, rim glow or aura around the enclosed object, no razor-sharp undisplaced outline, no insect, fossil, leaf or organic inclusion of any kind, no fantasy inner glow or self-illumination, no smooth featureless flawless block, no coloured gel light, no second product, immaculate craft-material clarity
